Please bear with us while we update the product pictures and demos. From gritty clean boost to tweed-like breakup to mild fuzz, the Purple Nurple Overdrive covers a lot of ground. Touch and volume control sensitivity allows you to choose how much and when, without having to change any settings - the Purple Nurple pays attention to what your picking hand and volume knob are telling it. Just plug in and go! As with all BMF Effects pedals, the Purple Nurple Overdrive features true bypass switching and a DC jack.
